en.t: Servius Tullius, king of Rome, celebrates the first of his three triumphs for his victory over the Etruscans
en.s: Servius Tullius was the legendary sixth king of Rome, and the second of its Etruscan dynasty. He reigned from 578 to 535 BC. Roman and Greek sources describe his servile origins and later marriage to a daughter of Lucius Tarquinius Priscus, Rome's first Etruscan king, who was assassinated in 579 BC.

zh.t: 罗马国王塞尔维乌斯·图利乌斯战胜伊特鲁里亚人，举行三次凯旋式中的首次
zh.s: 塞尔维乌斯·图利乌斯是传说中的罗马第六任国王，也是伊特鲁里亚王朝的第二位君主，在位时间为公元前578年至前535年。罗马和希腊史料称，他出身卑微，后来与罗马首位伊特鲁里亚国王卢修斯·塔克文·普里斯库斯之女结婚；卢修斯于公元前579年遭暗杀。

en.s: The siege of Paris of 885–886 was part of a Viking raid on the Seine, in the western part of the Frankish Empire. The siege was the most important event of the reign of Charles the Fat and a turning point in the fortunes of the Carolingian dynasty and the history of France.

zh.s: 885至886年的巴黎围城战是维京人沿塞纳河劫掠的一部分，地点位于法兰克帝国西部。这场围城战是胖子查理统治期间最重要的事件，也成为加洛林王朝命运和法国历史的转折点。

en.t: Accession of Duncan I of Scotland
en.s: Donnchad mac Crinain (Scottish Gaelic: Donnchadh mac Crìonain; anglicised as Duncan I, and nicknamed An t-Ilgarach, "the Diseased" or "the Sick"; c. 1001 – 14 August 1040) was king of Scotland (Alba) from 1034 to 1040. He is the historical basis of the "King Duncan" in Shakespeare's play Macbeth.

zh.t: 苏格兰国王邓肯一世即位
zh.s: 多恩查德·马克·克里南（苏格兰盖尔语：Donnchadh mac Crìonain；英语化为邓肯一世，绰号An t-Ilgarach，意为“患病者”；约1001年—1040年8月14日）于1034年至1040年担任苏格兰国王（阿尔巴国王）。莎士比亚戏剧《麦克白》中的“邓肯国王”以他为历史原型。

en.s: The White Ship (French: la Blanche-Nef; Medieval Latin: Candida navis) was a vessel transporting many nobles, including the heir to the English throne, that sank in the English Channel near the Normandy coast off Barfleur during a trip from France to England on 25 November 1120. Out of approximately 300 people aboard, only one – a butcher from Rouen – survived.

zh.s: 白船（法语：la Blanche-Nef；中世纪拉丁语：Candida navis）是一艘载有许多贵族的船只，其中包括英国王位继承人。1120年11月25日，该船从法国驶往英国途中，在巴夫勒尔外海的英吉利海峡、诺曼底海岸附近沉没。船上约300人中，只有一人幸存，是来自鲁昂的一名屠夫。

en.s: The Battle of Montgisard was fought between the Ayyubids and the Kingdom of Jerusalem on November 25, 1177. The 16-year-old King Baldwin IV, seriously afflicted by leprosy, led an out-numbered Christian force against the army of Saladin. The Arab force was routed and their casualties were massive, and only a fraction managed to flee to safety.

zh.s: 1177年11月25日，阿尤布王朝军队与耶路撒冷王国军队在蒙吉萨尔交战。16岁的耶路撒冷国王鲍德温四世身患严重麻风病，仍率领人数较少的基督徒军队迎战萨拉丁的军队。阿拉伯军队被击溃，伤亡惨重，只有一小部分人逃脱。

en.s: The Battle of Monmouth took place on 25 November 1233, the feast day of St Catherine, between forces loyal to Henry III, King of England, and those of Richard Marshal, Earl of Pembroke and Lord Marshal of England, who had formed an alliance with the Welsh prince Llywelyn ap Iorwerth and his supporter Owain ap Gruffydd, a grandson of Rhys of Deheubarth.

zh.s: 蒙茅斯战役于1233年11月25日圣凯瑟琳节当天发生。交战双方分别是效忠英格兰国王亨利三世的部队，以及理查·马歇尔率领的军队；理查是彭布罗克伯爵和英格兰元帅。他与威尔士王子卢埃林·阿普·约沃思及其支持者奥韦恩·阿普·格里菲斯结盟，后者是德赫巴思的里斯王子的孙子。

en.s: The 1343 tsunami struck the Tyrrhenian Sea and Bay of Naples on 25 November 1343. Underground shocks were felt in Naples and caused significant damage and loss of lives. Of major note was a tsunami created by the earthquake which destroyed many ships in Naples and destroyed many ports along the Amalfi Coast including Amalfi itself.

zh.s: 1343年11月25日，台勒尼安海和那不勒斯湾发生海啸。那不勒斯有震感，造成严重破坏和人员伤亡。地震引发的海啸摧毁了那不勒斯的许多船只，并毁坏阿马尔菲海岸沿线多个港口，其中包括阿马尔菲。

en.t: King Minkhaung I becomes king of Ava
en.s: Minkhaung I of Ava (Burmese: ပထမ မင်းခေါင် [pətʰəma̰ mɪ́ɰ̃ɡàʊɰ̃]; also spelled Mingaung; 1373–1421) was king of Ava from 1400 to 1421. He is best remembered in Burmese history for his epic struggles against King Razadarit of Hanthawaddy Pegu in the Forty Years' War (1385–1424). As king, Minkhaung continued his father Swa Saw Ke's policy to restore the Pagan Empire.

zh.t: 阿瓦国王敏康一世即位
zh.s: 阿瓦的敏康一世（缅甸语：ပထမ မင်းခေါင်；亦拼作Mingaung；1373—1421）于1400年至1421年担任阿瓦国王。他在缅甸历史上最为人熟知的是与勃固汉达瓦底国王拉扎达里特在1385—1424年四十年战争中的长期斗争。即位后，敏康延续父亲斯瓦绍克恢复蒲甘帝国的政策。

en.s: Buckingham's rebellion was a failed but significant uprising, or collection of uprisings, of October 1483 in England and parts of Wales against King Richard III of England. To the extent that these local risings had a central coordination, the plot revolved around Henry Stafford, 2nd Duke of Buckingham, who had become disaffected from Richard, and had backing from the exiled Henry Tudor (the future king Henry VII) and his mother Margaret Beaufort.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 白金汉叛乱是1483年10月在英格兰和威尔士部分地区发生的一场失败但影响重大的起义，也可能是一系列起义。就这些地方起义存在统一协调而言，阴谋核心人物是白金汉公爵亨利·斯塔福德。他对理查三世心生不满，并得到流亡中的亨利·都铎（后来的亨利七世）及其母亲玛格丽特·博福特支持。

en.t: Elizabeth of York is crowned Queen Consort of England
en.s: Elizabeth of York (11 February 1466 – 11 February 1503) was Queen of England from her marriage to King Henry VII on 18 January 1486 until she died in 1503. She was the daughter of King Edward IV and Elizabeth Woodville, and her marriage to Henry VII followed his victory at the Battle of Bosworth Field, which marked the end of the civil war known as the Wars of the Roses.

zh.t: 约克的伊丽莎白加冕为英格兰王后
zh.s: 约克的伊丽莎白（1466年2月11日—1503年2月11日）自1486年1月18日与亨利七世结婚起担任英格兰王后，直至1503年去世。她是爱德华四世与伊丽莎白·伍德维尔之女。她与亨利七世的婚姻发生在亨利于博斯沃思原野战役获胜之后，该战役标志着玫瑰战争结束。

en.s: The Treaty of Granada, also known as the Surrender of Granada or the Capitulations, was signed and ratified on November 25, 1491, between Boabdil, the sultan of Granada, and Ferdinand and Isabella, the King and Queen of Castile, León, Aragon, and Sicily. It ended the Granada War, which had started in 1482 and culminated in the siege and battle of Granada, which began in spring 1491.

zh.s: 格拉纳达条约也称格拉纳达投降书或《投降协定》，于1491年11月25日签署并批准。签约双方是格拉纳达苏丹博阿布迪尔，以及卡斯蒂利亚、莱昂、阿拉贡和西西里的国王与王后斐迪南和伊莎贝拉。条约结束了1482年开始的格拉纳达战争；战争在1491年春季开始的围城和格拉纳达战役后结束。

en.s: The Portuguese conquest of Goa occurred when the governor Afonso de Albuquerque captured the city in 1510 from the Sultanate of Bijapur. Old Goa became the capital of Portuguese India, which included territories such as Fort Manuel of Cochin, Bom Bahia, Damaon, and Chaul. It was not among the places Albuquerque was supposed to conquer. He did so after he was offered the support and guidance of Timoji and his troops.

zh.s: 1510年，葡萄牙总督阿方索·德·阿尔布克尔克从比贾布尔苏丹国手中夺取果阿。旧果阿后来成为葡属印度的首府，葡属印度还包括科钦的曼努埃尔堡、孟买、达曼和乔尔等地。果阿原本不在阿尔布克尔克计划征服的地点之列；后来他接受蒂莫吉及其部队的支持和指引，才攻占此地。

en.s: The Cudgel War (also known as the Club War; Finnish: Nuijasota; Swedish: Klubbekriget) was a 1596–1597 peasant uprising in Finland, which was then part of the Kingdom of Sweden. The name of the uprising derives from the fact that the peasants armed themselves with various blunt weapons, such as cudgels, flails, and maces, since they were seen as the most efficient weapons against their heavily armoured enemies.

zh.s: 棍棒战争又称“棍棒起义”，芬兰语名为Nuijasota，瑞典语名为Klubbekriget，是1596至1597年发生在芬兰的一场农民起义。当时芬兰属于瑞典王国。起义名称来自农民使用的钝器，包括棍棒、连枷和锤，因为这些武器被认为最适合对付身披重甲的敌人。

en.s: The Battle of Tuttlingen was part of the Thirty Years' War and was fought in Tuttlingen on 24 November 1643 between a French-led army under Marshal Josias Rantzau and the forces of the Holy Roman Empire, Bavaria, Spain, and the exiled Duke of Lorraine, all led by Franz von Mercy.

zh.s: 图特林根战役是三十年战争的一部分，于1643年11月24日在图特林根发生。法军由约西亚斯·朗佐元帅率领，对阵神圣罗马帝国、巴伐利亚、西班牙和流亡洛林公爵的联军；联军由弗朗茨·冯·梅西指挥。

en.s: The 1667 Shamakhi earthquake occurred on 25 November 1667 with an epicenter close to the city of Shamakhi, Azerbaijan (then part of Safavid Iran). It had an estimated surface-wave magnitude of 6.9 and a maximum felt intensity of X (Extreme) on the Mercalli intensity scale. An estimated 80,000 people died.

zh.s: 1667年11月25日发生沙马基地震，震中靠近阿塞拜疆沙马基市；当时该地属于萨法维伊朗。地震估计面波震级为6.9级，麦加利烈度最高达到X级（极震级）。估计有8万人死亡。

en.s: The Trunajaya Rebellion (also spelled Trunojoyo) or Trunajaya War was a conflict in the 1670s led by the Madurese prince Trunajaya and Makassarese fighters against the Mataram Sultanate and the Dutch East India Company (VOC) in Java (in modern-day Indonesia). The uprising was initially successful; the rebels gained Gegodog (1676), the majority of Java's north coast (1677), and the capital of Mataram (1677) from the royal army.
en.n: Trunajaya rebellion: After a long and logistically challenging march, the allied Mataram and Dutch troops successfully assault the rebel stronghold of Kediri.

zh.s: 特鲁纳贾亚起义又称特鲁诺约起义或特鲁纳贾亚战争，是17世纪70年代在爪哇（今印度尼西亚）发生的一场冲突。马都拉王子特鲁纳贾亚与望加锡战士领导起义，反对马打蓝苏丹国和荷兰东印度公司。起义初期取得成功，叛军先后从王室军队手中夺取格戈多格（1676年）、爪哇北海岸大部分地区（1677年），以及马打蓝首都（1677年）。
zh.n: 特鲁纳贾亚起义期间，马打蓝和荷兰联军经过艰难且后勤困难的长途行军后，成功攻下叛军在谏义里的据点。

en.t: Trunajaya rebellion: After a series of difficult marches, allied Mataram and Dutch troops successfully assaulted the rebel stronghold of Kediri in eastern Java
en.s: In a campaign that took place from August to December 1678 in Kediri (in modern-day East Java, Indonesia) during the Trunajaya rebellion, the forces of the Mataram Sultanate, led by Amangkurat II, and of the Dutch East India Company (VOC), led by Anthonio Hurdt, marched inland into eastern Java against Trunajaya's forces.

zh.t: 特鲁纳贾亚叛乱：经过一系列艰难行军后，马打兰与荷兰联军成功攻占爪哇东部叛军据点谏义里
zh.s: 1678年8月至12月的特鲁纳贾亚叛乱期间，阿曼古拉特二世率领马打兰苏丹国军队，安托尼奥·赫尔特率领荷兰东印度公司（VOC）军队，向东爪哇内陆进军，攻打谏义里（今印度尼西亚东爪哇省）的特鲁纳贾亚部队。

en.s: The siege of Landau of 1704 was the third of four such sieges during the War of the Spanish Succession. It lasted 77 days from 9 September to 25 November 1704, when the French garrison surrendered to the forces of the Grand Alliance. Following the Allied victory at the Battle of Blenheim on 13 August 1704, the remnant of the French Army of Alsace under Ferdinand de Marsin withdrew towards Strasbourg while the Army of Flanders under the Duc de Villeroy covered its retreat.

zh.s: 1704年的兰道围城战是西班牙王位继承战争期间四次围城战中的第三次。围城持续77天，从9月9日到11月25日；当天，法军守军向大同盟军投降。1704年8月13日盟军在布伦海姆战役获胜后，阿尔萨斯法军残部在费迪南·德·马尔桑率领下撤往斯特拉斯堡，佛兰德斯军团则由维拉尔公爵掩护撤退。

en.s: The Siege of Fribourg took place between September and November 1744 during the War of the Austrian Succession. After Charles VI's death several members of his family competed to be his heir. Bavaria and Spain formed an alliance in 1741 through the Treaty of Nymphenburg, which Prussia, Saxony, France, Sweden, Naples, the Palatinate and the Electorate of Cologne joined later.

zh.s: 弗赖堡围城战发生于1744年9月至11月，是奥地利王位继承战争的一部分。查理六世去世后，王室成员争夺继承权。巴伐利亚和西班牙于1741年签订《尼姆芬堡条约》结盟，普鲁士、萨克森、法国、瑞典、那不勒斯、普法尔茨和科隆选侯国后来也加入。

en.s: The Battle of Chinsurah (also known as the Battle of Biderra) took place near Chinsurah, India on 25 November 1759 during the Seven Years' War between a force of British troops mainly of the British East India Company and a force of the Dutch East India Company which had been invited by the Nawab of Bengal Mir Jafar to help him eject the British and establish themselves as the leading commercial company in Bengal. Despite Britain and the Dutch Republic not formally being at war, the Dutch advanced up the Hooghly River. They met a mixed force of British and local troops at Chinsurah, just outside Calcutta.

zh.s: 钦苏拉战役也称比德拉战役，于1759年11月25日在印度钦苏拉附近爆发，属于七年战争的一部分。交战双方是英国军队（主要来自英国东印度公司）和荷兰东印度公司军队。孟加拉纳瓦卜米尔·贾法尔邀请荷兰人帮助他驱逐英国人，并让荷兰公司成为孟加拉的主导商业公司。尽管英国和荷兰共和国并未正式开战，荷兰军队仍沿胡格利河推进，并在加尔各答郊外的钦苏拉遇到一支由英军和当地部队组成的混合军队。

en.s: The Battle of Gloucester was a skirmish fought on November 25, 1777, during the Philadelphia campaign of the American Revolutionary War. It was the first battlefield command for the Marquis de Lafayette.

zh.s: 格洛斯特战役是美国独立战争费城战役期间于1777年11月25日发生的一场小规模冲突。这是拉法叶侯爵首次在战场上指挥部队。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held in Virginia on November 25, 1785. The incumbent governor of Virginia Patrick Henry was re-elected. The election was conducted by the Virginia General Assembly in joint session. Henry was selected by a majority of members on the first ballot; the official record of the proceedings does not include the names or tallied votes for any other candidates.

zh.s: 弗吉尼亚州于1785年11月25日举行州长选举，现任州长帕特里克·亨利再次当选。选举由弗吉尼亚州议会联席会议举行。亨利在首轮投票中获得多数议员支持。官方会议记录没有记载其他候选人的姓名或得票数。

en.t: End of the reign of Stanisław August Poniatowski
en.s: Stanisław II August (born Stanisław Antoni Poniatowski; 17 January 1732 – 12 February 1798), known also by his regnal Latin name Stanislaus II Augustus, and as Stanisław August Poniatowski (Lithuanian: Stanislovas Augustas Poniatovskis), was King of Poland and Grand Duke of Lithuania from 1764 to 1795, and the last monarch of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth.

zh.t: 斯坦尼斯瓦夫·奥古斯特·波尼亚托夫斯基统治结束
zh.s: 斯坦尼斯瓦夫二世·奥古斯特（原名斯坦尼斯瓦夫·安东尼·波尼亚托夫斯基；1732年1月17日—1798年2月12日），也称拉丁文王号斯坦尼斯劳斯二世·奥古斯都，或斯坦尼斯瓦夫·奥古斯特·波尼亚托夫斯基（立陶宛语：Stanislovas Augustas Poniatovskis），于1764年至1795年担任波兰国王和立陶宛大公，也是波兰立陶宛联邦最后一位君主。

en.s: The 1801 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 25, 1801, in order to elect the Governor of North Carolina. Incumbent Federalist Governor Benjamin Williams was re-elected by the North Carolina General Assembly against Democratic-Republican candidate and former member of the U.S. House of Representatives from North Carolina's 3rd district John Baptista Ashe and fellow Democratic-Republican candidate and former Federalist Governor Richard Dobbs Spaight.

zh.s: 1801年北卡罗来纳州州长选举于1801年11月25日举行，选出该州州长。联邦党籍现任州长本杰明·威廉姆斯由北卡罗来纳州议会再次选任，击败民主共和党候选人约翰·巴普蒂斯塔·阿什（曾任联邦众议院北卡罗来纳州第3选区议员），以及民主共和党候选人、前联邦党籍州长理查德·多布斯·斯派特。

en.s: The First Battle of Opatow, one of many clashes of the January Uprising, took place on November 25, 1863, in the town of Opatow, which at that time belonged to Russian-controlled Congress Poland. A party of 210 Polish rebels, commanded by Józef Hauke-Bosak, managed to temporarily capture the town, which was defended by a 180-strong garrison of the Imperial Russian Army. Polish rebels took advantage of the fact that main Russian forces had left Opatow, to chase rebel units operating near the town of Ilza. Hauke-Bossak ordered an attack from three sides. Weak Russian garrison was unable to defend the town, and was pushed out of Opatow.

en.s: The First Battle of Adobe Walls was a battle between the United States Army and American Indians. The Kiowa, Comanche and Plains Apache (Kiowa Apache) tribes drove from the battlefield a United States Expeditionary Force that was reacting to attacks on white settlers moving into the Southwest. en.t: The United States Greenback Party is established as a political party consisting primarily of farmers affected by the Panic of 1873
en.s: The Greenback Party (known successively as the Independent Party and the Greenback Labor Party) was an American political party with an anti-monopoly ideology which was active from 1874 to 1889. The party ran candidates in three presidential elections, in 1876, 1880 and 1884, before it dissolved. The party's name referred to the non-gold backed paper money, commonly known as "greenbacks", that had been issued by the North during the American Civil War and shortly afterward.

en.s: The Battle of Ngomano or Negomano was fought between the German Empire and Portugal during the East African Campaign of World War I. A force of Germans and Askaris under Paul Emil von Lettow-Vorbeck had just won a costly victory against the British at the Battle of Mahiwa, in present-day Tanzania and ran very short of supplies. To find food, the Germans invaded Portuguese East Africa to the south, to escape superior British forces to the north and supply themselves with captured Portuguese materiel. Portugal was part of the Entente and a belligerent, employing troops in France and a force under Major João Teixeira Pinto was sent to stop von Lettow-Vorbeck from crossing the border.

It was the fourth and final general election victory in a row for Taschereau, who had held office since 1920.

en.s: The Anti-Comintern Pact, officially the Agreement against the Communist International, was an anti-communist pact concluded between Nazi Germany and the Empire of Japan on 25 November 1936 and directed against the Communist International (Comintern). It was signed by the German ambassador-at-large Joachim von Ribbentrop and the Japanese ambassador to Germany Kintomo Mushanokōji.

zh.s: 《反共产国际协定》的正式名称是《反对共产国际协定》。这是一项反共协定，由纳粹德国和日本帝国于1936年11月25日缔结，针对共产国际。协定由德国无任所大使约阿希姆·冯·里宾特洛甫和日本驻德国大使武者小路公共签署。

en.s: Operation Harling, also known as the Battle of Gorgopotamos (Greek: Μάχη του Γοργοπόταμου) in Greece, was a World War II mission by the British Special Operations Executive (SOE), in cooperation with the Greek Resistance groups EDES and ELAS, which destroyed the heavily guarded Gorgopotamos viaduct in Central Greece on 25 November 1942. This was one of the first major sabotage acts in Axis-occupied Europe, and the beginning of a permanent British involvement with the Greek Resistance.

zh.s: 哈林行动也称戈尔戈波塔莫斯战役（希腊语：Μάχη του Γοργοπόταμου），是英国特别行动执行处与希腊抵抗组织EDES和ELAS合作执行的一次二战任务。1942年11月25日，行动人员在希腊中部摧毁了戒备森严的戈尔戈波塔莫斯高架桥。这是轴心国占领的欧洲最早几次重大破坏行动之一，也标志着英国开始长期介入希腊抵抗运动。

en.s: The Battle of Sattelberg took place between 17 and 25 November 1943, during the Huon Peninsula campaign of the Second World War. Involving forces from Australia, the United States and Japan, the fighting centred on the Sattelberg mission station which was situated atop a hill about 900 metres (3,000 ft) above sea level, approximately 8 kilometres (5.0 mi) inland from Finschhafen, New Guinea.

zh.s: 萨特尔贝格战役于1943年11月17日至25日进行，是第二次世界大战休恩半岛战役的一部分。澳大利亚、美国和日本军队均参与战斗。战斗围绕萨特尔贝格传教站展开，该站位于新几内亚芬什哈芬内陆约8公里（5英里）处的一座山顶，海拔约900米（3000英尺）。

en.s: The Battle of Cape St. George was a naval battle of the Pacific campaign of World War II fought on 25 November 1943, between Cape St. George, New Ireland, and Buka Island (now part of the North Solomons Province in Papua New Guinea). It was the last engagement of surface ships in the Solomon Islands campaign.

zh.s: 圣乔治角海战是第二次世界大战太平洋战役中的一场海战，于1943年11月25日在新爱尔兰的圣乔治角与布卡岛之间海域进行。布卡岛如今属于巴布亚新几内亚北所罗门省。这是所罗门群岛战役中水面舰艇之间的最后一场交战。

en.s: The Battle of Piva Forks, also known as the Battle of Numa–Numa Trail, was an engagement that took place during the Bougainville campaign in World War II. Occurring between 18 and 25 November 1943 on Bougainville Island in the South Pacific, the battle involved troops from the United States Marine Corps and the United States Army fighting against Imperial Japanese Army forces and took place amidst the context of the expansion of a beachhead that US forces had established around Torokina on the western side of the island.

zh.s: 皮瓦叉路战役也称努马—努马小径战役，是第二次世界大战布干维尔战役期间的一场交战，于1943年11月18日至25日在南太平洋布干维尔岛发生。美国海军陆战队和美国陆军与日本帝国陆军交战。战斗发生时，美军正在岛屿西侧的托罗基纳周围扩大滩头阵地。

en.s: The Battle of Monte Castello (Italian: Battaglia del Monte Castello; German: Schlacht von Monte Castello; Portuguese: Batalha de Monte Castello) was a major engagement fought between 25 November 1944 and 21 February 1945 during the Italian campaign of World War II. Fought in the northern Apennine Mountains, the battle pitted the advancing Allied forces—primarily the Brazilian Expeditionary Force (Força Expedicionária Brasileira – FEB) alongside the US 10th Mountain Division—against heavily entrenched defenders of the Wehrmacht's 232nd Infantry Division.

zh.s: 蒙特卡斯特洛战役（意大利语：Battaglia del Monte Castello；德语：Schlacht von Monte Castello；葡萄牙语：Batalha de Monte Castello）是第二次世界大战意大利战役期间的一场重要交战，于1944年11月25日至1945年2月21日在亚平宁山脉北部进行。正在推进的盟军主要包括巴西远征军和美国陆军第10山地师，他们的对手是驻扎在坚固阵地上的德国国防军第232步兵师。

en.s: The elections to the Austrian National Council held on 25 November 1945 were the first after World War II. The elections were held according to the Austrian election law of 1929, with all citizens at least 21 years old eligible to vote, however former Nazis were banned from voting, official sources putting their numbers at around 200,000. The Communist Party of Austria only gained four seats, which some blamed on the conduct of the Red Army in the Soviet occupied zone of Austria. This was highly embarrassing for the Communists, who had assured the Soviets that they could win as much as 30 percent of the vote.

zh.s: 奥地利于1945年11月25日举行国民议会选举，这是第二次世界大战结束后的首次选举。选举依照1929年奥地利选举法举行，年满21岁的公民均有投票权，但前纳粹党员被禁止投票。官方估计被禁投票的前纳粹党员约有20万人。奥地利共产党只赢得4席，有人将其归咎于红军在奥地利苏占区的行为。这让共产党颇为难堪，因为他们曾向苏联保证能够获得多达30%的选票。

en.s: The UN offensive into North Korea was a large-scale offensive in late 1950 by United Nations (UN) forces against North Korean forces during the Korean War. On 27 September near Osan, UN forces coming from Inchon linked up with UN forces that had broken out of the Pusan Perimeter and began a general counteroffensive. The North Korean Korean People's Army (KPA) had been shattered, and its remnants were fleeing back towards North Korea.

zh.s: 联合国军攻入朝鲜是朝鲜战争期间，1950年末联合国军对朝鲜军队发动的一次大规模攻势。9月27日，从仁川出发的联合国军在乌山附近与从釜山防御圈突围的联合国军会合，并开始全面反攻。朝鲜人民军已遭重创，残部正向朝鲜境内撤退。

en.s: The Battle of Triangle Hill, also known as Operation Showdown or the Shangganling Campaign (Chinese: 上甘岭战役; pinyin: Shànggānlǐng Zhànyì), was a protracted military engagement during the Korean War. The main combatants were two United Nations (UN) infantry divisions, with additional support from the United States Air Force, against elements of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army (PVA) 15th and 12th Corps.

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Sudan on 2 and 25 November 1953, prior to the implementation of home rule. The result was a victory for the National Unionist Party, which won 51 of the 97 seats in Parliament. The NUP also obtained a majority in the Senate, where they won 21 of the 30 indirectly elected seats (elected by local and provincial councils) and 10 of the 20 members were nominated to the Senate by the British Governor-General. Although the Umma Party and some of the British press alleged that Egypt had interfered in the election, it was generally seen as free and fair.

zh.s: 苏丹于1953年11月2日和25日举行议会选举，时间在自治制度实施之前。民族统一党获胜，赢得议会97席中的51席。该党还在参议院占多数，赢得30个间接选举席位中的21席；这些席位由地方和省级议会选出。参议院另有20名成员由英国总督任命。乌玛党和部分英国媒体指称埃及干预选举，但普遍认为选举自由且公正。

en.t: Match of the Century (1953 England v Hungary football match)
en.s: On 25 November 1953, Hungary – then the Olympic champions and on a run of 24 unbeaten games, and England, hailing from the birthplace of football, played an exhibition game which became known as the Match of the Century. Hungary won 6–3 and the result led to a review of the training and tactics used by the England team, and adoption of continental practices at international and club level in the English game.

zh.t: 世纪之战（1953年英格兰对匈牙利足球赛）
zh.s: 1953年11月25日，奥运冠军匈牙利队和英格兰队进行了一场友谊赛，后来被称为“世纪之战”。匈牙利此前连续24场不败，被认为是足球强队；英格兰则来自足球的发源地。匈牙利以6比3获胜。赛果促使英格兰队检讨训练和战术，并在国内俱乐部和国际比赛中采用欧洲大陆的做法。

en.s: The 1953 Bulgarian Cup final was the 13th final of the Bulgarian Cup (in this period the tournament was named Cup of the Soviet Army), and was contested between Lokomotiv Sofia and Levski Sofia on 25 November 1953 at Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia. Lokomotiv won the final 2–1, claiming their second national cup title.

zh.s: 1953年保加利亚杯决赛是该赛事的第13届决赛；当时赛事称为苏军杯。索非亚火车头队与索非亚列夫斯基队于1953年11月25日在索非亚瓦西尔·列夫斯基国家体育场进行决赛。索非亚火车头队以2比1获胜，第二次夺得全国杯赛冠军。

en.s: The 1955 election for the sixth Senate of South Africa occurred because of the desire of National Party Prime Minister Johannes Strijdom to amend one of the entrenched clauses in the Constitution, to separate Coloured voters from whites. However, since his party did not have the constitutionally required two-thirds majority in a joint session of both houses of Parliament, it was decided to alter the composition and electoral system for the Senate, to enable the Separate Representation of Voters Act 1951 to be validated.

zh.s: 1955年南非举行第六届参议院选举，起因是国民党总理约翰内斯·斯特赖东希望修改宪法中的一项固化条款，将有色人种选民与白人选民分开。由于国民党在两院联席会议中未达到修宪所需的三分之二多数，政府决定调整参议院组成和选举制度，以便使《1951年选民分别代表法》获得批准。

en.s: The 1958 Alaska gubernatorial election took place on November 25, 1958 for the post of governor of Alaska. This was Alaska's first gubernatorial election as a U.S. state, although this did not actually take effect until January 3, 1959. Democratic State Senator Bill Egan defeated Republican State Senator John Butrovich, Jr..

zh.s: 阿拉斯加州长选举于1958年11月25日举行。这是阿拉斯加成为美国一州后的首次州长选举，不过该州地位要到1959年1月3日才正式生效。民主党州参议员比尔·伊根击败共和党州参议员约翰·布特罗维奇二世。

en.t: 1958 United States Senate elections in Alaska
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate elections in Alaska were held November 25, 1958. The elections were held in anticipation of Alaska's admission as the forty-ninth state in the union, effective January 3, 1959. The state held two simultaneous elections to determine their first senators. Both elections were won by the Democratic Party.

zh.t: 1958年美国参议院阿拉斯加州选举
zh.s: 阿拉斯加州于1958年11月25日举行美国参议院选举，为其于1959年1月3日正式成为美国第49个州作准备。该州同时举行两场选举，选出首任参议员。两席均由民主党赢得。

en.t: The three sisters were assassinated on 25 November 1960
en.s: The Mirabal sisters (Spanish: hermanas Mirabal [eɾˈmanas miɾaˈβal]) were four sisters from the Dominican Republic, three of whom (Patria, Minerva and María Teresa) opposed the dictatorship of Rafael Trujillo (el Jefe) and were involved in activities against his regime. The three sisters were assassinated on 25 November 1960. The last sister, Adela (known as Dedé), who was not involved in political activities at the time, died of natural causes on 1 February 2014.

zh.s: 米拉瓦尔姐妹来自多米尼加共和国，共有四人。其中帕特里娅、米涅娃和玛丽亚·特蕾莎反对拉斐尔·特鲁希略的独裁统治，并参与反对其政权的活动。三人于1960年11月25日遇害。最后一位姐妹阿德拉（昵称德德）当时没有参与政治活动，于2014年2月1日自然去世。

en.s: French legislative elections took place on 18 November and 25 November 1962 to elect the second National Assembly of the Fifth Republic. Since 1959 and the change of Algerian policy (Charles de Gaulle decided in favour of the "self-government" and "Algerian Algeria"), France had faced bomb attacks by the Secret Armed Organization (Organisation armée secrète or OAS) which opposed the independence of Algeria, negotiated by the FLN with the March 1962 Evian agreements and approved by referendum by the French people. This policy was disapproved by some members of the "Presidential Majority".

zh.s: 法国于1962年11月18日和25日举行立法选举，选出第五共和国第二届国民议会。自1959年以来，戴高乐改变对阿尔及利亚的政策，支持“自治”和“阿尔及利亚人的阿尔及利亚”；反对阿尔及利亚独立的秘密军队组织（OAS）因此在法国发动炸弹袭击。阿尔及利亚民族解放阵线（FLN）通过1962年3月的《埃维昂协议》与法国谈判独立，并由法国公投通过。总统多数派的一些成员反对这一政策。

en.s: The Northern Ireland general election, 1965 was held on 25 November 1965. Like all previous elections to the Parliament of Northern Ireland, it produced a large majority for the Ulster Unionist Party. This was the last election in Northern Ireland in which one party won a majority of the vote. The Ulster Unionists increased their vote share largely due to a reduction in the number of uncontested seats, but also picked up two additional seats. Similarly, the Nationalist vote share decreased largely due to more of the seats in which they stood candidates being contested.

zh.s: 北爱尔兰于1965年11月25日举行大选。与此前北爱尔兰议会的所有选举一样，阿尔斯特统一党赢得了压倒性多数。这是北爱尔兰最后一次由单一政党赢得过半选票的选举。该党得票率上升，主要是因为无人竞争的席位减少，同时还多赢得两席。类似地，民族主义者的得票率下降，主要是因为他们派出候选人的选区中有更多选区出现竞争。

en.s: The second Mobutu coup d'état, launched on November 25, 1965, was a successful coup attempt in the Republic of the Congo (Léopoldville) by General Joseph Mobutu which overthrew President Joseph Kasa-Vubu and Prime Minister Evariste Kimba. The coup was caused by the political impasse between President Kasa-Vubu and Moïse Tshombe, which threatened to develop into a violent confrontation and destabilize the country even further.

zh.s: 第二次蒙博托政变于1965年11月25日发动，是刚果共和国（利奥波德维尔）的约瑟夫·蒙博托将军发动的一次成功政变，推翻了总统约瑟夫·卡萨武布和总理埃瓦里斯特·金巴。卡萨武布与莫伊兹·冲伯之间的政治僵局导致政变，局势当时有可能演变为暴力冲突，进一步破坏国家稳定。

en.s: Operation Attleboro was a Vietnam War search and destroy operation initiated by the 196th Light Infantry Brigade with the objective to discover the location(s) of People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) and Viet Cong (VC) base areas and force them to fight. The operation was named after Attleboro, Massachusetts, where the brigade had been formed.

en.s: Half-senate elections were held in Australia on 25 November 1967. There was no accompanying election to the House of Representatives as the two election cycles had been out of synchronisation since 1963. The results were a setback for the government of Harold Holt. Having won a landslide victory the previous year, the Coalition instead lost two seats in the Senate. The Australian Labor Party failed to make any gains; the Democratic Labor Party gained two seats would hold the balance of power until 1974.

zh.s: 澳大利亚于1967年11月25日举行半数参议院改选。由于两轮选举自1963年以来不同步，本次没有同时举行众议院选举。选举结果令哈罗德·霍尔特政府受挫。执政联盟前一年刚取得压倒性胜利，本次却在参议院失去两席。澳大利亚工党没有增加席位；民主工党则增加两席，并一直在参议院掌握关键票数至1974年。

en.s: The Coup of 25 November 1975 (usually referred to as the 25 de Novembro in Portugal) was a failed military coup against the post-Carnation Revolution governing bodies of Portugal. This attempt was carried out by Portuguese communists and other left-wing activists, who hoped to halt the Portuguese transition to democracy in favor of a Communist system. Vasco Gonçalves, the previous Prime Minister, from July 1974 to September 1975, later described the coup as a "provocation" organised by the sixth provisional government, saying that the government had ordered the paratroopers to bomb the occupied Rádio Renascença.

zh.s: 1975年11月25日政变是一次针对葡萄牙康乃馨革命后执政机构的未遂军事政变。葡萄牙共产党和其他左翼活动人士发动政变，希望建立共产主义制度，阻止葡萄牙向民主转型。前总理瓦斯科·贡萨尔维斯（1974年7月至1975年9月任职）后来称这次政变是第六届临时政府策划的“挑衅”，并说政府曾命令伞兵轰炸被占领的文艺复兴电台。

en.t: Suriname becomes independent from the Netherlands
en.s: Suriname became independent on November 25, 1975, following negotiations with the Dutch government. The country had previously been a constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands.

en.s: The 1978 New Zealand general election was a nationwide vote to elect the 39th New Zealand Parliament. It saw the governing National Party, led by Robert Muldoon, retain office, but the opposition Labour Party won the largest share of the vote. Reorganisation of the enrolment system caused major problems with the electoral rolls, which left a legacy of unreliable information about voting levels in this election.

zh.s: 1978年新西兰大选用于选出第39届议会。罗伯特·马尔登领导的执政国家党继续执政，但反对党工党获得了最高比例的选票。选民登记制度重组引发严重问题，选民名册因此出现偏差，这也使该次选举的投票率数据一直不可靠。

en.s: The 1980 Upper Voltan coup d'état took place on 25 November 1980 in the Republic of Upper Volta (today Burkina Faso). Following a long period of drought, famine, popular unrest and labour strikes, Colonel Saye Zerbo overthrew President Sangoulé Lamizana, another military leader. Zerbo himself would be overthrown only two years later.

zh.s: 1980年11月25日，上沃尔特共和国（今布基纳法索）发生政变。长期干旱、饥荒、民众动荡和罢工后，赛耶·泽尔博上校推翻了另一位军人总统桑古莱·拉米扎纳。两年后，泽尔博本人也被推翻。

en.s: The 1981 Seychelles coup d'état attempt, sometimes referred to as the Seychelles affair or Operation Angela, was a failed South African–orchestrated coup to overthrow the government of Prime Minister France-Albert René in Seychelles and restore the previous president, James Mancham, to power. The South African government encouraged a mercenary group to force a change of government.

zh.s: 1981年塞舌尔政变未遂有时也称“塞舌尔事件”或“安吉拉行动”。这是一起由南非策划、企图推翻塞舌尔总理弗朗斯-阿尔贝·勒内政府并让前总统詹姆斯·曼查姆重新掌权的政变，最终失败。南非政府鼓动一支雇佣兵队伍发动政权更迭。

en.s: The Battle of the Mountains (Somali: Dagaalkii Buuraha) took place on November 25, 1984, during the Somali Civil War. The conflict was a key confrontation between the Somali National Movement (SNM) and the Somali government forces under President Siad Barre. The SNM launched an assault on the mountainous regions of Somaliland, aiming to resist the oppressive regime and secure the region's autonomy.

zh.s: 山地战役（索马里语：Dagaalkii Buuraha）于1984年11月25日索马里内战期间发生。索马里民族运动（SNM）与总统西亚德·巴雷领导的政府军交战。SNM向索马里兰山区发动进攻，试图抵抗专制政权并争取该地区自治。

en.s: The 1985 Soviet Air Force Antonov An-12 shoot down occurred on November 25, 1985, in Angola during the Angolan Civil War and South African Border War. An Aeroflot Antonov An-12BP cargo aircraft operated by the Soviet Air Force flying from Cuito Cuanavale to Luanda was shot down, allegedly by South African Special Forces, and crashed approximately 43 kilometres (27 mi) east of Menongue in Angola's Cuando Cubango province.

zh.t: 1985年苏联空军安-12运输机被击落事件
zh.s: 1985年11月25日，安哥拉内战和南非边境战争期间，一架苏联空军运营的俄罗斯航空公司安东诺夫An-12BP货机在安哥拉被击落。飞机从奎托夸纳瓦莱飞往罗安达，据称遭南非特种部队击落，并在安哥拉宽多库邦戈省门农盖以东约43公里（27英里）处坠毁。

en.s: State elections were held in South Australia on 25 November 1989. All 47 seats in the South Australian House of Assembly were up for election. The incumbent Australian Labor Party led by Premier of South Australia John Bannon defeated the Liberal Party of Australia led by Leader of the Opposition John Olsen. Labor won 22 out of 47 seats, and secured a majority of 24 with the support of two Independent Labor members.

zh.s: 南澳大利亚州于1989年11月25日举行州选举，改选州众议院全部47席。州长约翰·班农领导的现任澳大利亚工党政府击败了反对党领袖约翰·奥尔森领导的澳大利亚自由党。工党赢得47席中的22席，并在两名独立工党议员支持下取得24席多数。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Poland on 25 November 1990, with a second round on 9 December. They were the first direct presidential elections in the history of Poland, and the first free presidential elections since the May Coup of 1926. Before World War II, presidents were elected by the Sejm. From 1952 to 1989--the bulk of the Communist era--the presidency did not exist as a separate institution, and most of its functions were fulfilled by the State Council of Poland. The leader of the Solidarity movement, Lech Wałęsa, won the first round.

zh.s: 波兰于1990年11月25日举行总统选举，第二轮投票于12月9日举行。这是波兰历史上首次直接总统选举，也是1926年五月政变以来首次自由总统选举。第二次世界大战前，总统由众议院选出；1952年至1989年共产主义时期的大部分时间里，总统职位并非独立机构，其大部分职能由波兰国务委员会履行。团结工会运动领袖莱赫·瓦文萨在首轮投票中获胜。

en.s: The Maranhão gubernatorial election of 1990 was held in the Brazilian state of Maranhão on October 3, alongside Brazil's general elections, with a second round on November 25. PFL candidate, Edison Lobão, was elected on November 25, 1990.

en.s: The Irish general election of 1992 was held on Wednesday, 25 November 1992, almost three weeks after the dissolution of the Dáil on 5 November. The newly elected 166 members of the 27th Dáil assembled at Leinster House on 14 December 1992, but a new Taoiseach was not elected. A new Fianna Fáil-Labour Party coalition government was not appointed until 12 January 1993 after Albert Reynolds was re-elected Taoiseach. The general election took place in 41 parliamentary constituencies throughout Ireland for 166 seats in Dáil Éireann.

zh.s: 爱尔兰于1992年11月25日星期三举行大选，距11月5日众议院解散约三周。新当选的第27届众议院166名议员于1992年12月14日在伦斯特宫开会，但没有选出新总理。直到1993年1月12日艾伯特·雷诺兹再次当选总理后，爱尔兰共和党与工党的新联合政府才获任命。此次大选在爱尔兰全国41个议会选区举行，改选爱尔兰国会众议院166个席位。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Madagascar on 25 November 1992, with a run-off between the top two contenders on 10 February 1993. Incumbent President Didier Ratsiraka of AREMA lost the election to Albert Zafy, leader of the National Union for Development and Democracy in the second round after neither candidate reached 50% in the first round. Voter turnout was 74.43% for the first round and 68.49% for the second.

zh.s: 马达加斯加于1992年11月25日举行总统选举，得票前两名的候选人于1993年2月10日参加第二轮投票。时任总统、AREMA党候选人迪迪埃·拉齐拉卡未能连任；首轮无人获得50%的选票后，国家发展与民主联盟领袖阿尔贝·扎菲在第二轮击败了他。首轮投票率为74.43%，第二轮为68.49%。

en.s: The 1992 Survivor Series was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF, now WWE). It was the sixth annual Survivor Series and took place on Thanksgiving Eve in the United States on Wednesday, November 25, 1992, at the Richfield Coliseum in Richfield Township, Ohio, which was the third time a Survivor Series was held there after the 1987 and 1988 events.

en.s: Early general elections were held in Tuvalu on 25 November 1993, after the previous elections in September had resulted in a deadlock in Parliament, with supporters of incumbent and former Prime Ministers Bikenibeu Paeniu and Tomasi Puapua holding an equal number of seats. zh.s: 1998年11月，印度米佐拉姆邦举行立法议会选举，选出40个选区的议员。米佐民族阵线赢得最多席位，并与米佐拉姆人民会议党组成联合政府；不过，由于米佐民族阵线自身席位已足以单独组阁，联合政府不久便解散。该党领袖佐拉姆唐加出任米佐拉姆邦首席部长。

en.s: On 25 November 2000, at 22:09 (18:09 AZT), a Mw 6.8 earthquake struck with an epicenter just offshore Baku, Azerbaijan. It was followed a minute later by a Mw 6.5 event. The mainshock resulted in 35 mostly indirect fatalities and 600 injuries.

en.s: W.A.K.O. World Championships 2001 were the joint thirteenth world kickboxing championships (the other was held earlier that year in Maribor, Slovenia) hosted by the W.A.K.O. organization. It was the second championships to be held in Serbia and Montenegro (the Europeans had been held here back in 1996) and was open to amateur men and women across the world. There were three styles on offer at Belgrade; Full-Contact, Low-Kick (men only) and Thai-Boxing (men only). The other typical styles, Semi Contact, Musical Forms etc., had taken place at the sister event in Maribor.

zh.t: 2001年W.A.K.O.世界锦标赛（贝尔格莱德站）
zh.s: 2001年W.A.K.O.世界锦标赛（贝尔格莱德站）是该组织第十三届联合踢拳世界锦标赛之一；同年另一场赛事在斯洛文尼亚马里博尔举行。这是塞尔维亚和黑山第二次举办该项锦标赛，此前当地于1996年举办过欧洲锦标赛。比赛面向全球男女业余选手，设全接触、低踢（仅男子）和泰拳（仅男子）三个项目。半接触和套路等项目则安排在同年马里博尔举行的另一场赛事中。

en.s: The 2006 Victorian state election, held on Saturday, 25 November 2006, was for the 56th Parliament of Victoria. en.s: A by-election was held on 25 November 2010 in the Donegal South-West constituency in Ireland, following the election of the Fianna Fáil Teachta Dála (TD) Pat the Cope Gallagher to the European Parliament at the June 2009 election. Most voters cast their ballot on 25 November 2010; 754 voters on offshore islands (Arranmore, Tory, Inishbofin, Gola, and Inishfree) were entitled to cast their ballots on 22 November. The government through a vote in the parliament decides when by-elections are called. With a rather tenuous majority in the parliament, the government had delayed in calling this by-election.

zh.s: 爱尔兰多尼戈尔西南选区于2010年11月25日举行补选。爱尔兰共和党议员帕特·“科普”·加拉格尔于2009年6月当选欧洲议会议员后，该席位出缺。大多数选民于2010年11月25日投票；阿兰莫尔岛、托里岛、伊尼斯博芬岛、戈拉岛和伊尼斯弗里岛的754名选民可于11月22日投票。议会投票决定何时举行补选。由于政府在议会中的多数优势并不稳固，补选日期一再推迟。

en.s: The 2012 Norwegian Football Cup final was the 107th final of the Norwegian Football Cup. The final was contested by Hødd and Tromsø and took place on 25 November 2012 at Ullevaal Stadion in Oslo, in front of a crowd of 24,217. This was Tromsø's third final, and they had won the two previous finals in 1986 and 1996, while the Norwegian First Division side Hødd played their first final ever.

zh.s: 2012年挪威足球杯决赛是第107届决赛，由赫于德队对阵特罗姆瑟队，于2012年11月25日在奥斯陆的乌勒瓦尔球场举行，现场观众为24217人。这是特罗姆瑟第三次参加决赛，此前两次于1986年和1996年夺冠。来自挪威甲级联赛的赫于德队则是首次闯入决赛。

en.s: A Legislative Assembly election was held on 25 November 2013 in Madhya Pradesh, India, with the result announced on 8 December. Along with other provincial elections, these were the first five elections in which the Election Commission of India implemented a "None of the above" (NOTA) voting option, allowing the electorate to register a neutral vote but not to outright reject candidates. In a first, the Election Commission of India also appointed Central Awareness Observers, whose main task was to oversee voter awareness and facilitation.

zh.s: 中央邦于2013年11月25日举行立法议会选举，结果于12月8日公布。这是印度选举委员会首次在五次选举（包括其他省级选举）中实施“以上皆非”（NOTA）选项。选民可以选择不支持任何候选人，但不能直接拒绝所有候选人。选举委员会还首次任命中央选民意识观察员，主要负责监督选民宣传和投票便利措施。

en.s: The Kerch Strait incident was an international incident that occurred on 25 November 2018 in the Kerch Strait, during which the Russian Federal Security Service (FSB) coast guard fired upon and captured three Ukrainian Navy vessels after they attempted to transit from the Black Sea into the Sea of Azov through the strait on their way to the port of Mariupol.

en.s: The 2018 Starrcade was a professional wrestling streaming event produced by WWE, held for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brands, Raw and SmackDown. It was WWE's second annual Starrcade and 20th overall. The event took place on Saturday, November 24, 2018, at the U.S. Bank Arena in Cincinnati, Ohio, with a portion of it airing on November 25 as a one-hour WWE Network special.

en.s: The 2019 Liga 2 final was the final match of the 2019 Liga 2, the tenth season of second-tier competition in Indonesia organised by PT Liga Indonesia Baru, and the third season since it was renamed from the Liga Indonesia Premier Division to the Liga 2. zh.t: 2019年印度尼西亚乙级联赛决赛

en.s: Local elections were held in the Indian state of Tripura on 25 November 2021 to elect 222 of the 334 seats in one Municipal Corporation, 13 Municipal Councils and 6 Nagar Panchayats. The polls were hit with widespread violence and accusations of rigging. On polling day, the Supreme Court ordered the Ministry of Home Affairs to deploy two additional companies of Central paramilitary forces to ensure free and fair election in Tripura.

zh.s: 印度特里普拉邦于2021年11月25日举行地方选举，改选1个市政公司、13个市政委员会和6个市政镇议会的334席中的222席。投票期间出现大范围暴力，也有人指控选举舞弊。投票日当天，最高法院命令内政部增派两支中央准军事部队，以确保选举自由、公正。

en.t: 2021 North Yorkshire Police, Fire and Crime Commissioner by-election
en.s: A by-election was held on 25 November 2021 for the North Yorkshire Police, Fire and Crime Commissioner post after the resignation of Philip Allott following his remarks on the murder of Sarah Everard. The election was won by the Conservative Party candidate Zoë Metcalfe. Nominations opened on 21 October. The candidates contesting the election were Zoë Metcalfe (Conservative), Emma Scott-Spivey (Labour), James Barker (Liberal Democrats), Keith Tordoff (Independent) and Hannah Barham-Brown (Women's Equality Party).

zh.t: 2021年北约克郡警察、消防与犯罪事务专员补选
zh.s: 2021年11月25日，北约克郡警察、消防与犯罪事务专员职位举行补选。此前，菲利普·阿洛特因就莎拉·埃弗拉德遭谋杀一事发表言论而辞职。保守党候选人佐伊·梅特卡夫赢得选举。候选人提名于10月21日开放，参选者还有工党的艾玛·斯科特-斯皮维、自由民主党的詹姆斯·巴克、独立候选人基思·托多夫，以及女性平等党的汉娜·巴勒姆-布朗。

en.s: The PFL 10 mixed martial arts event for the 2022 season of the Professional Fighters League was held on November 25, 2022, at the Hulu Theater in New York City, New York. en.s: Throwback Throwdown III was a professional wrestling event produced by Impact Wrestling. It was taped at Benton Convention Center in Winston-Salem, North Carolina on November 25, 2022 as part of WrestleCade, and aired on December 2, 2022 on Impact Plus and YouTube. It was the third event under the Throwback Throwdown chronology. The event also featured wrestlers from independent promotions.

en.t: 2022 São Tomé and Príncipe coup attempt
en.s: The 2022 São Tomé and Príncipe coup attempt was an attempted coup d'état that is reported to have taken place on the island nation of São Tomé and Príncipe overnight on 24–25 November 2022. At a press conference held on 25 November, the nation's prime minister, Patrice Trovoada, said that the country's armed forces headquarters had come under attack from four men, including Delfim Neves (who was later exonerated and released), president of the outgoing National Assembly, and Arlecio Costa, a military officer who had attempted a previous coup in 2003.

en.s: Legislative Assembly elections were held in Rajasthan on 25 November 2023 to elect 199 of the 200 members of Rajasthan Legislative Assembly. The results were declared on 3 December 2023. The election for the Karanpur seat was adjourned following the death of Rajasthan PCC candidate Gurmeet Singh Kooner. The BJP Rajasthan wrested power by winning 115 seats, unseating the Indian National Congress from power and continuing the trend of governments changing every five years in the state.

zh.s: 拉贾斯坦邦于2023年11月25日举行立法议会选举，改选200席中的199席。结果于2023年12月3日公布。人民党候选人古尔米特·辛格·库纳尔去世后，卡兰普尔选区的选举延期。印度人民党在拉贾斯坦邦赢得115席、夺回执政权，使印度国民大会党下台，并延续了该邦每五年更换执政党的趋势。

en.s: The 2023 Port Waikato by-election was held on 25 November 2023. The by-election was triggered by the death of Neil Christensen, who was a candidate for the ACT Party. Christensen's death occurred after the close of candidate nominations for the 2023 New Zealand general election, but before polling day. The by-election was won by National incumbent Andrew Bayly, who has held the Port Waikato seat and its predecessor Hunua since 2014.

en.s: Indirect presidential elections were held in Jubaland, Somalia, on 25 November 2024. The incumbent president Ahmed Mohamed Islam was re-elected by members of the House of Representatives as the President of Jubaland for a third term. It was the third election since the state's formation in 2012. Prior to the elections, the Parliament Speaker and other Deputy Speakers were elected on 21 November, by the House of Representatives of Jubaland.

zh.s: 索马里朱巴兰于2024年11月25日举行间接总统选举。时任总统艾哈迈德·穆罕默德·伊斯兰由朱巴兰众议院议员再次选为总统，开始第三个任期。这是朱巴兰自2012年成立以来的第三次选举。选举前，众议院议长和其他副议长于11月21日由众议院选出。
